patch_list: Swift Backup Cloud Backup Without Sign-In

Lets an anonymous account connect file-based cloud providers (SMB, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP, S3, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, Mega, Filen, Drime, Yandex, pCloud, Mail.ru) and run cloud backups/restores without signing in with Google.
Swift Backup Local Account Backup
Extends Export/Import settings with labels, configs, schedules, the cloud backup catalog and UI preferences so the local account survives a reinstall.
Swift Backup Local Cloud Metadata
Makes cloud backups work by keeping their metadata on the device and the connected cloud instead of the Swift Backup server.
Swift Backup Premium Unlock
Unlocks all Premium features.
Swift Backup Tamper Protection
Stops the app from closing itself on patched installs.
Swift Backup Web Login
Makes Google sign-in work for connecting cloud accounts.

patch_list: Swift Backup Blacklist Limit
Raises the shared blacklist limit from 100 to 1,000 apps.
Swift Backup Cloud Apps Visibility
Displays all backups present in the cloud tag without dropping blacklisted or system apps.
Swift Backup Cloud Settings Backup
Adds opt-in automatic cloud backup and explicit restore for settings, favorites, and the blacklist.
Swift Backup Cloud WiFi Backups
Detects and restores existing WiFi backups from cloud storage when metadata is missing from the local database.
Swift Backup Local Cloud Metadata
Makes cloud backups work by keeping their metadata on persistent local storage and syncing to the connected cloud.
Swift Backup Premium Unlock
Unlocks all Premium features.
Swift Backup Settings Export and Import
Shows Export settings and Import settings for signed-in users, including blacklist transfer.
Swift Backup Tamper Protection
Stops the app from closing itself on patched installs.
Swift Backup Web Login
Makes Google sign-in work for connecting cloud accounts.
